author: sonnet
label: c2-seed-sonnet-01
changes: Replaced the one-line summary and the bare diagram with a document covering all four flows in one Mermaid diagram with Notes
Added a state-location table showing where each piece of state lives, including that plaintext is stored nowhere and validity is not cached
Added the rules (token format, name, expiry, limit, last-used throttling, ownership) so the document stands alone
Added the limit check, the name check, expiry computation, and the concurrency guard on create
Showed the failure paths: limit reached, bad token with a uniform 401, lost create response with its recovery, foreign-token revoke, failed last-used write
Showed how last-used is recorded: written only when null or older than 1 hour, which gives at most one write per token per hour
Replaced the vague 'usual 4xx codes' with specific status codes and a failure summary table
Distinguished session-cookie calls from Bearer-token calls and labeled the participants clearly
Explained that revoke takes effect on the next request because every API call reads the database with no cache
Clarified the table row for the plaintext token ('Nowhere stored') and the token record row ('New Postgres table').
Reworded 'Shown once' rule to say first that the token appears only in the create response.
Added a note in the limit branch of the diagram saying the count check shown is the sequential case and concurrent creates are handled at the INSERT step, so the two safeguards are not confusing.
Made 'database write' explicit in the Last used rule.
Moved the sentence about session-cookie vs Bearer callers up from the Diagram section into the intro, so the reader knows the two caller types before the table.
Reworded the plaintext row from 'Nowhere stored' to 'Not stored anywhere'.
Replaced the confusing 'Shown for the sequential case' note on the limit branch with 'This is the normal path', and said the INSERT step covers simultaneous creates.
Clarified the INSERT note: the concurrency guards protect the 'name or limit rules' instead of vague 'the rules'.
Reworded 'The token is shown only in the create response' to 'The token appears only in the create response'.
